messages.subject: Permanent link to Shiny app
parts:
I am hoping to link to a Shiny app I constructed in a paper. I am hoping to use a link that does not expire. Right now, I am simply typing a https URL like the following (https://userName.shinyapps.io/appName) into my paper.

However, will this link expire? If so, is there a suggested method to provide a link to an app that will not (or be less likely to) expire? Thank you.

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Permanent link to Shiny app
parts:
There is nothing about that link intrinsically that has an expiration.

However, should you desire more control and a layer of indirection, you could look into a URL shortening service such as bitly or Rebrandly.
